crack_segmentation.description: SegFormer-B5 @1024, run crack_segformer_b5, 40 epochs. Best validation IoU 0.6063 during training; the shipped decision threshold of 0.85 was chosen by sweep on the validation split, scoring 0.5962 against 0.5582 at the previous 0.25. The higher threshold trades recall for precision on purpose: at 0.25 the model painted crack over enough sound surface to make the masks hard to trust. READ THE THRESHOLD BEFORE READING A MASK. At 0.85 thin and faint cracks are missed, so an empty mask is not evidence of a sound surface. SCOPE: this locates crack extent for measurement; it is NOT a triage model and is the weaker of the two crack models. crack_presence_classifier answers 'is there a crack here' far more reliably (balanced accuracy 0.958) and should gate which tiles reach this one. Crack WIDTH is not measured by this model -- width at survey GSD is usually below one pixel, and a width read off these masks would be a statement about the resolution rather than the crack. Not measured on Indian sites.

solar_cell_defect_detector.description: YOLO11l @1024 on PVEL-AD electroluminescence cells, run pvel_ad_yolo11l, 60 epochs. Validation mAP50 0.8835, mAP50-95 0.5434, P 0.812, R 0.856. Per-class mAP50-95: short_circuit 0.918, black_core 0.847, finger 0.540, horizontal_dislocation 0.504, thick_line 0.485, star_crack 0.393, vertical_dislocation 0.335, crack 0.325. SCOPE: this is an EL cell-level defect detector for module manufacturing and lab inspection imagery. It is NOT an aerial or thermal model and must not be applied to drone photographs of installed panels. Four of the twelve classes PVEL-AD declares (printing_error, corner, fragment, scratch) had under 35 boxes each and were dropped rather than trained, so this model answers eight questions and cannot see those four defect types at all. Label order is the model checkpoint order, which predates the sorted-index fix in the corpus builder; any re-validation must use these labels rather than a freshly prepared data.yaml.

solar_thermal_anomaly_classifier.description: ResNet18 @96 on Raptor Maps InfraredSolarModules, run solar_thermal_cls, 26 epochs (early-stopped). Validation balanced accuracy 0.724, plain accuracy 0.815. Every one of the 12 classes is recalled; none is ignored. READ PER-CLASS RECALL, NOT THE MEAN. The corpus is 10,000 No-Anomaly against 249 Hot-Spot and 204 Soiling, so a single averaged figure hides exactly the rare classes the model exists to find. Recall by class: Diode 0.969, Diode-Multi 0.957, No-Anomaly 0.926, Shadowing 0.809, Vegetation 0.722, Hot-Spot-Multi 0.719, Offline-Module 0.707, Hot-Spot 0.650, Cracking 0.646, Cell 0.635, Cell-Multi 0.537, SOILING 0.367. SOILING IS THE WEAK CLASS at 0.367 recall and 0.344 precision on 30 validation samples: roughly two in three soiled modules are missed, and a third of soiling calls are wrong. Do not report soiling findings from this model without saying so. SCOPE: the source crops are 24x40 px upsampled to 96, so this is a PER-MODULE CLASSIFIER over polygons something else must already have located. It is not a localiser and cannot find modules in a survey image. Balanced accuracy selected the checkpoint; plain accuracy would have chosen a model that answers No-Anomaly to everything.

rail_corridor_segmentation.description: SegFormer-B2 @512 on UAV-RSOD, run rail_corridor_segformer_b2, 60 epochs. Validation IoU 0.681, Dice 0.810, precision 0.752, recall 0.878. ONNX parity max_abs_diff 2.4e-07 and cv2.dnn loads it. CORPUS SIZE IS THE CAVEAT: about 315 distinct Indian UAV images, emitted as 315 samples after one mask aspect was selected. That is small enough that 0.681 is a first indication rather than a settled figure, and it has not been tested outside the flights it was trained on. SCOPE: segments the rail CORRIDOR surface only. The archive also masks Rail Lines as a separate binary aspect over the same imagery; that was deliberately excluded rather than merged, because the source states no ordering between the two and training on both would have given the model two contradictory definitions of foreground for the same pixel. A rails model is a separate run, not a class here.

crack_presence_classifier.description: ResNet18 @224 on the merged crack classification corpus, run crack_cls on a Kaggle P100, 20 epochs. Validation balanced accuracy 0.9575, plain accuracy 0.9659 over 14,399 held-out tiles. Both classes are recalled: cracked 0.931 recall / 0.954 precision on 4,322 samples, uncracked 0.981 / 0.971 on 10,077. Balanced accuracy selected the checkpoint. SCOPE: this answers 'is there a crack in this tile', nothing more. It is NOT a localiser and must not be used to report where a crack is, how long it is, or how wide -- crack_segmentation is the model for that, and it is the weaker of the two (IoU 0.637). The honest division is that this one triages tiles and the segmenter measures the ones it flags; a high number here says nothing about the quality of any geometry downstream. The corpus is tiles of concrete and pavement surfaces at close range. Performance on aerial imagery at survey altitude is unmeasured, and the 2:1 class balance here is far richer in cracks than any real structure, so the precision figure will not survive contact with a corpus that is mostly sound surface.

rail_obstacle_detector.description: YOLO11l @640 on the rail corridor obstacle corpus, trained on a Kaggle P100, 60 epochs. Validation mAP50 0.824, mAP50-95 0.493, precision 0.762, recall 0.743 over 273 held-out images. All six classes are predicted; none is ignored. Per-class mAP50-95: Barrel 0.590, Boulder 0.532, IronRod 0.531, Person 0.493, Jerrycan 0.418, Branch 0.395. READ THE RECALL BEFORE USING THIS FOR SAFETY. At 0.743 overall recall roughly one obstacle in four is missed, and Person is mid-table at 0.493 mAP50-95. This model must NOT be presented as clearing a track: an empty result means the model found nothing, not that the corridor is safe. It is a review aid that flags candidates for a human, and a track cleared on its silence would be cleared on no evidence. SCOPE: trained on 1,338 corridor images of discrete objects lying on or beside track. It does not detect track geometry faults, ballast condition, missing fasteners, or vegetation encroachment, and it has not been measured on Indian railway imagery.
